root_cause: LinkedIn dispatch is Composio-only, but the supervisor still executed a legacy Buffer sync without containment, so a Buffer network/provider failure could abort the broader content loop.
The content orchestrator collapsed every non-2xx Anthropic response into AI_PROVIDER_REQUEST_FAILED, hiding the HTTP status and model needed for autonomous diagnosis.
On 2026-09-25 the artifact-ai stage failed repeatedly, leaving both LinkedIn decisions at decided with no content artifacts.
The production Anthropic account returned invalid_request_error because its credit balance was too low, proving the generator had a financial/provider single point of failure.

Personal LinkedIn create and readback were coupled in one throwing function. If create succeeded but LINKEDIN_GET_POST_CONTENT was forbidden, the created post URN was discarded before persistence, creating duplicate ambiguity.

Decision reconciliation did not treat blocked republish-forbidden or possible-provider-side-effect claims as preserved, so a later scheduler cycle could theoretically re-decide an ambiguous daily claim.

Duplicate prevention was claim/provider-centric instead of content-history-centric: there was no global database uniqueness reservation over final social copy, so the same content or a lightly rewritten version could be published on another date/channel.
prevention: LinkedIn personal and company publication authority remains Composio-only with exact provider URN readback and no Buffer fallback.
Legacy Buffer sync is compatibility telemetry only, is explicitly non-blocking, and records degraded state instead of failing the LinkedIn loop.
AI provider failures retain only sanitized HTTP status and model identity; provider payloads and secrets are never logged.
The content AI call has a bounded 45-second timeout so a hung provider cannot stall a scheduler run.

For provider HTTP 400 validation failures, retain only sanitized provider error type/message so request-shape defects can be repaired deterministically without logging prompts, source data, or credentials.

Use the separately approved supabase-bg-composio-content-fallback-v1 route only for explicit provider-availability failures (credit exhaustion, missing key, 401/403/429, or 5xx), never for ordinary validation/programming defects.

Composio fallback generation must return exactly the existing six-string artifact schema and remains subject to all downstream personal-truth, company-tracking, identity, publication-authority, dedupe and exact-URN readback gates.

After any successful personal LinkedIn create, persist the returned URN and create-success evidence even when exact readback fails; mark verification pending and republish forbidden, then reconcile only that exact URN.
The orchestrator must preserve any existing claim with republish_forbidden, possible_provider_side_effect, or a persisted provider_create_success plus delivery_ref, regardless of blocked state.

Every final social post must atomically reserve its final text in powerhouse_publication_uniqueness_v1 before any provider side effect. Exact raw/normalized hashes and near-duplicate 3-word-shingle similarity are hard blockers.

evidence.production_observation: 84 powerhouse-content-orchestrator health rows on 2026-09-25 reported artifact-ai:AI_PROVIDER_REQUEST_FAILED before remediation.
evidence.linkedin_transport: powerhouse-social-publisher has dedicated Composio branches for linkedin_personal and linkedin_company, exact LINKEDIN_GET_POST_CONTENT readback, buffer_dependency:false and republish_forbidden fail-closed handling.
evidence.anthropic_400: Post-deploy production readback on 2026-09-25 proved HTTP 400 for claude-sonnet-4-6; the diagnostic now retains only provider error type/message capped at 240 characters, never request payloads or credentials.
evidence.anthropic_credit_exhaustion: Production health on 2026-09-25: invalid_request_error: credit balance too low.
evidence.composio_fallback_dry_run: COMPOSIO_SEARCH_GROQ_CHAT with openai/gpt-oss-120b returned a valid six-key JSON artifact; legacy llama-3.3-70b-versatile returned model_not_found and is not used.
evidence.personal_urn_loss_incident: On 2026-09-25 the personal lane reached LINKEDIN_GET_POST_CONTENT after create and received Forbidden, but the old catch path recorded no delivery_ref/external_id. The claim is treated as possibly written and is not retried.
